typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SourceSystemId as long,
		SourceSystemCode as string,
		SourceSystemName as string,
		SourceSystemDesc as string,
		LoadDate as timestamp,
		AutoAsOfDateInd as string,
		BatchId as integer,
		StagingDB as string,
		ClaimMergeHistoryInd as short,
		SourceSystemURL as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * ,StagingDB = Cast(db_name() as nvarchar(75)) from Control.SourceSystem',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		SourceSystemId as long,
		SourceSystemCode as string,
		SourceSystemDesc as string,
		BusinessKeyHash as string,
		ContentHash as string,
		StagingDBName as string,
		SourceSystemURL as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from Control.SourceSystem',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource derive(SourceSystemId = SourceSystemId) ~> PlaceHolderYodilHashTransformation
PlaceHolderYodilHashTransformation,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(PlaceHolderYodilHashTransformation@SourceSystemCode == LookupLKPTABLE@SourceSystemCode,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		ContentHash = YodilHashTransformation@ContentHash,
		BusinessKeyHash = YodilHashTransformation@BusinessKeyHash,
		BusinessKeyHashInput = BusinessKeyHashInput,
		SourceSystemDesc = YodilHashTransformation@SourceSystemDesc,
		SourceSystemName = SourceSystemName,
		SourceSystemCode = YodilHashTransformation@SourceSystemCode,
		SourceSystemId = YodilHashTransformation@SourceSystemId,
		StagingDBName = StagingDBName,
		SourceSystemURL = SourceSystemURL
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup01
Lookup01 filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		SourceSystemURL as string,
		ContentHash as string,
		SourceSystemDesc as string,
		StagingDBName as string,
		SourceSystemCode as string,
		BusinessKeyHash as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		SourceSystemURL,
		ContentHash,
		SourceSystemDesc,
		StagingDBName = StagingDB,
		SourceSystemCode,
		BusinessKeyHash)) ~> DSTSourceSystem
